name: search-one-plan-charge
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys,json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.cwd();plan={'queries':['"uniquely restricted" "girth" "conjecture" counterexample','"bipartite" "girth" "empty" "expander" matching']}
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'plans/search-one.json'],input=json.dumps(plan),capture_output=True,text=True);print(r.stdout);assert r.returncode==0
print((p/'search-budget.json').read_text());print((p/'search-charges.jsonl').read_text() if (p/'search-charges.jsonl').exists() else 'no prior charges');print((p/'guard-ledger.jsonl').read_text())
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'charge_search.py'),'plans/search-one.json'],capture_output=True,text=True);print(r.stdout);print(r.stderr);sys.exit(r.returncode)
